messages:
nina (arch): thinking about a small, invertible 'thermostat' for route priorities — objective: penalize routes that recently caused tail latency or that show high cold-start frequency so we avoid routing latency-sensitive tenants to them. idea: combine cost_score with two quick signals: latency_miss_rate and cold_start_rate. simple formula to start: weight' = base_weight * exp(k_lat*latency_miss + k_cold*cold_start_rate). want thoughts on stability and ops complexity
eli (runtime): curious how you plan to compute cold_start_rate. per-host sliding window? per-model? per-route?
sam (sre): also think about circuit-breaker behavior. if weight drops quickly we might thrash routing. need cooldown and manual overrides.
maria (ml-infra): we should simulate with tail-heavy traces first. also cold_start can be noisy — long-tail preemption events look like cold starts. need to define metric precisely: is it kernel-warm vs container-warm vs full-model-load?
sara (product): from customer POV we need an escape hatch. per-tenant knobs to disable auto-thermostat, otherwise can surprise customers on cost/latency.
nina (arch): good q on definition. my thought: cold_start_rate = fraction of requests hitting a route where KV-cache_miss AND model_load_time > X ms within last N minutes. keep it coarse to avoid per-instance churn. we can make k_lat/k_cold tenant-configurable defaults.
eli (runtime): exponential penalty can blow up. consider sigmoid clamping or a low-pass on the penalty term. e.g. penalty = 1 + clamp(sigmoid(s) - 0.5, -m, m). avoids huge multiplicative swings and is easier to bound in scheduler.
sam (sre): +1 to bounding. also require a minimum weight floor so route doesn't drop to zero and become unrecoverable. add jitter to updates to avoid synchronized re-routes.
maria (ml-infra): for simulation we'll need two scenarios: (A) steady-state with occasional cold starts, (B) flash cold storm (rolling upgrades). measure routing oscillation, client-visible tail, and operator interventions. i can generate traces if you define X and N.
nina (arch): pseudo-snippet: ```
# inputs: base_weight, latency_miss_rate (0..1), cold_rate (0..1)
pen = k_lat*latency_miss_rate + k_cold*cold_rate
bounded = max(-max_pen, min(max_pen, pen))
penalty = 1 + tanh(bounded) * max_mul_frac
new_weight = base_weight * penalty
# then low-pass: new_weight = alpha*new_weight + (1-alpha)*old_weight
```
sara (product): we should surface this in Console with simple explanation and a graph (penalty over time) + toggle per route. customers will want SLA guarantees vs best-effort optimization.
eli (runtime): one more: compute penalty at route-group granularity rather than per-tenant when traffic is low to reduce noise. only enable per-tenant when we have >= threshold QPS.
sam (sre): operational checklist: rollout as off by default, shadow mode for 48h, canary to 5% traffic, auto-escalation to disable if operator marks >N incidents, observability: trend of weights, re-route rate, tenants impacted.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary run: "thermostat-priority-canary" will start at 2026-04-02T09:00Z for 2h against edge-region-us-west with traffic=5%
maria (ml-infra): i'll prepare sim traces and a dashboard with: simulated tail latency, weight oscillation, re-route counts. baseline vs thermostat.
nina (arch): plan: write short RFC with formula + simulation results + config surface. target: shadow for 2 weeks, then canary 5% if stable. thanks — will ping when RFC lands :thumbsup:
